description: NaSrVF₆ crystallizes in the orthorhombic P2_12_12₁ space group. Na is bonded to six F atoms to form distorted NaF₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaF₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent VF₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent VF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 52-71°. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.44 Å. Sr is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven F atoms. There are a spread of Sr-F bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.77 Å. V is bonded to six F atoms to form VF₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaF₆ octahedra and edges with two equivalent NaF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 52-54°. There are a spread of V-F bond distances ranging from 1.96-2.00 Å. There are six inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na, one Sr, and one V atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Sr, and one V atom. In the third F site, F is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na, one Sr, and one V atom. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Sr and one V atom. In the fifth F site, F is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Sr, and one V atom. In the sixth F site, F is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Sr, and one V atom.
